bs02.subject: Your free home survey, Mohammed
bs02.body:
Hi Mohammed,

Thanks for getting in touch. A five-bedroom home with two EVs and people working from home is a good fit for solar and a battery, and a south-facing roof is a strong start.

I can't promise a fitting date until we've seen the roof, but the next step is a free home survey. You can pick a slot here: https://book.example.com/brightside-survey

Systems like this typically cost £6,000 to £14,000 installed, and we offer 0% finance over 5 years. Our installers are MCS certified.

If it's easier, reply with a good time to call and I'll ring you.

Priya
Brightside Solar
bs02.rationale: No email address is on file, only a phone number, so this should be sent by SMS or used as a call script until an email is captured; it's drafted to get him to book the free survey quickly as he has a competing quote that can't fit before February.

rf01.subject: Resilient leased line for your Swindon warehouse
rf01.body:
Hi Sian,

Thanks for getting in touch. Losing the line several times a week is a serious problem for a warehouse running scanners and a cloud WMS, and it's understandable you want something resilient with a backup in place before your current contract ends in the next three months.

We provide dedicated leased lines from £295 a month on 36-month terms, and we can look at a backup路线 alongside the main circuit so one fault doesn't stop operations. Installation normally takes 30 to 60 working days, so starting now makes sense.

The next step is a short site survey to confirm what your building can support and the bandwidth you need. You can book a time here: https://book.example.com/ridgeway-site-survey

If it's easier, reply with a couple of times that suit and I'll arrange a call.

Priya
Ridgeway Fibre
rf01.rationale: Sian has a clear, time-sensitive need (3-month contract end, frequent drops) and has asked for a resilient leased line, so a prompt survey booking is the right next step.
